description: Synthetic buyer support knowledge for the Northwind Marketplace demo.

branches.agent_script: Organisations register once, then add their purchasing staff as users. I'll walk you through it.
steps: Ask the caller for the organisation's legal name and official email domain.
Guide them to 'Register as buyer' and complete the organisation form.
Explain that an approving officer must be nominated during registration.
Tell them approval takes up to two business days.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Organisation Onboarding → Register a new buyer organisation
branches.description: Organisations register once, then add their purchasing staff as users. I'll walk you through it.

branches.agent_script: Purchases above the direct-buy limit need an approving officer. Let's assign one.
steps: Confirm the caller is the organisation admin.
Guide them to Organisation > Approval hierarchy.
Have them select an existing user as approving officer or invite a new one.
Explain that pending purchases resume once the officer accepts.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Organisation Onboarding → Approving officer not assigned
branches.description: Purchases above the direct-buy limit need an approving officer. Let's assign one.

branches.agent_script: Organisation details can be corrected by the admin, with a supporting letter for name changes.
steps: Ask which field is incorrect.
For address or contact changes, guide the admin to Organisation > Details.
For name changes, collect an official letter on letterhead.
Explain that name changes are reviewed within two business days.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Organisation Onboarding → Organisation details are incorrect
branches.description: Organisation details can be corrected by the admin, with a supporting letter for name changes.

branches.agent_script: Let's get your login code through. Delays usually come from SMS filtering or an outdated number.
steps: Confirm the last four digits of the registered mobile number.
Ask the caller to wait 60 seconds before pressing 'Resend OTP' once.
Offer the email OTP option if available.
If the number is outdated, start the mobile update process with the organisation admin.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Login & OTP → Buyer OTP not received
branches.description: Let's get your login code through. Delays usually come from SMS filtering or an outdated number.

branches.agent_script: Accounts lock for 30 minutes after five failed attempts. I can help you reset safely.
steps: Tell the caller how long remains on the lock.
Recommend a password reset once the lock lifts.
If urgent, verify identity with the organisation admin and raise an unlock request.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Login & OTP → Buyer account locked
branches.description: Accounts lock for 30 minutes after five failed attempts. I can help you reset safely.

branches.agent_script: Mobile numbers are updated by verifying both the email and the new number.
steps: Ask the caller to open Profile > Contact details.
Have them verify the change with an email OTP.
Then verify the new number with an SMS OTP.
If they can't access the email, the organisation admin must approve the change.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Login & OTP → Update registered mobile number
branches.description: Mobile numbers are updated by verifying both the email and the new number.

branches.agent_script: Organisation admins can add buyers and assign purchase limits per user.
steps: Confirm the caller is the organisation admin.
Guide them to Organisation > Users > Add user.
Have them set the role and the per-order purchase limit.
Explain that the new user activates from the invitation email.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Users & Roles → Create a new buyer user
branches.description: Organisation admins can add buyers and assign purchase limits per user.

branches.agent_script: Deactivating departed users keeps your organisation's purchases secure. Their open orders can be reassigned.
steps: Ask the admin to open Organisation > Users and select the user.
Choose 'Deactivate' and reassign their open orders to another buyer.
Explain that order history stays available for audits.
documents: Name of the user to deactivate
branches.tagging: Buyer → Users & Roles → Deactivate a user who left
branches.description: Deactivating departed users keeps your organisation's purchases secure. Their open orders can be reassigned.

branches.agent_script: Roles and purchase limits are set by the organisation admin and take effect on next login.
steps: Ask which permission or limit needs to change.
Guide the admin to Organisation > Users > Edit role.
Explain that limits above the organisation cap need approving officer sign-off.
Ask the user to sign out and back in.
documents: Approving officer sign-off for higher limits
branches.tagging: Buyer → Users & Roles → Change buyer role or permissions
branches.description: Roles and purchase limits are set by the organisation admin and take effect on next login.

branches.branch_name: Price changed after adding to cart
branches.agent_script: Prices in the cart refresh from the seller's live listing. Let's check what changed.
steps: Ask the caller to open the cart and read the 'price updated' notice.
Explain that sellers can change prices until checkout.
Suggest comparing with similar listings before confirming.
If the price changed after checkout, collect the order number and escalate.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Direct Purchase → Price changed after adding to cart
branches.description: Prices in the cart refresh from the seller's live listing. Let's check what changed.

branches.agent_script: Direct purchases have a value cap. Above it, you'll need approval or a bid.
steps: Ask for the cart value and the caller's purchase limit.
If under the organisation cap, request approval from the approving officer.
If above the organisation cap, explain that a bid or RFQ is required.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Direct Purchase → Direct purchase limit exceeded
branches.description: Direct purchases have a value cap. Above it, you'll need approval or a bid.

branches.agent_script: The comparison view shows up to four listings side by side, so you can choose the best value.
steps: Ask the caller to tick 'Compare' on up to four listings.
Explain the columns: price, delivery time, seller rating and warranty.
Remind them to record the reason if they don't choose the lowest price.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Direct Purchase → Compare products before purchase
branches.description: The comparison view shows up to four listings side by side, so you can choose the best value.

branches.agent_script: An RFQ invites sellers to quote for your requirement. I'll guide you through publishing one.
steps: Guide the caller to Sourcing > Create RFQ.
Have them enter specifications, quantity and delivery location.
Ask them to set a bid deadline at least seven days away.
Explain that the approving officer must approve before publishing.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Bids & RFQs → Create a request for quotation
branches.description: An RFQ invites sellers to quote for your requirement. I'll guide you through publishing one.

branches.agent_script: You can extend a bid deadline before it closes; sellers are notified automatically.
steps: Ask for the bid number.
Check that the deadline hasn't passed.
Guide the caller to Bid > Amend > Extend deadline.
Explain that a reason is recorded and visible to sellers.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Bids & RFQs → Extend bid deadline
branches.description: You can extend a bid deadline before it closes; sellers are notified automatically.

branches.agent_script: Evaluation results must be uploaded in the provided template. Let's check the file.
steps: Ask for the bid number and the error message.
Confirm the file uses the latest evaluation template.
Check that every participating seller has a qualified or disqualified status with remarks.
Ask the caller to retry the upload.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Bids & RFQs → Technical evaluation upload failed
branches.description: Evaluation results must be uploaded in the provided template. Let's check the file.

branches.agent_script: Order status updates when the seller records dispatch. Let's check the latest event.
steps: Ask for the order number.
Check the last status event and its timestamp.
If the seller hasn't marked dispatch, send a reminder to the seller.
If dispatched, share the tracking link with the caller.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Orders & Delivery → Order status not updated
branches.description: Order status updates when the seller records dispatch. Let's check the latest event.

branches.agent_script: The consignee can be changed before dispatch, with the seller's agreement.
steps: Ask for the order number and the new consignee details.
Check that the order hasn't been dispatched.
Guide the caller to Order > Request consignee change.
Explain that the seller must accept the change.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Orders & Delivery → Change consignee after ordering
branches.description: The consignee can be changed before dispatch, with the seller's agreement.

branches.agent_script: If delivery is overdue, you can follow up with the seller and penalties apply automatically.
steps: Ask for the order number and the promised delivery date.
Check whether the seller requested an extension.
If not, send a delivery follow-up to the seller.
Explain how late delivery penalties are calculated.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Orders & Delivery → Delivery overdue
branches.description: If delivery is overdue, you can follow up with the seller and penalties apply automatically.

branches.agent_script: Generating the goods receipt confirms delivery and starts the seller's payment cycle.
steps: Ask the caller to open the order and choose 'Generate receipt'.
Have them enter quantity received and inspection result.
Explain that the receipt must be generated within 10 days of delivery.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Receiving & Inspection → Generate goods receipt
branches.description: Generating the goods receipt confirms delivery and starts the seller's payment cycle.

branches.agent_script: You can reject damaged items during receipt; the seller is asked to replace them.
steps: Ask the caller to record the damage with photos.
During receipt, mark the affected quantity as rejected with a reason.
Explain that the seller has seven days to replace the items.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Receiving & Inspection → Reject damaged goods
branches.description: You can reject damaged items during receipt; the seller is asked to replace them.

branches.agent_script: For partial deliveries, receipt the quantity you received; the rest stays open.
steps: Ask how many units were received against the order quantity.
Guide the caller to receipt only the received quantity.
Explain that the balance remains open for the seller to deliver.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Receiving & Inspection → Partial delivery receipt
branches.description: For partial deliveries, receipt the quantity you received; the rest stays open.

branches.agent_script: After receipt, the invoice must be approved before payment releases. Let's find which step is pending.
steps: Ask for the order number.
Check whether the invoice was approved by the finance user.
If not approved, guide the finance user to Payments > Pending invoices.
If approved, check the payment batch status and share the reference.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Payments & Invoices → Payment not processed after receipt
branches.description: After receipt, the invoice must be approved before payment releases. Let's find which step is pending.

branches.agent_script: Sellers upload the invoice after your goods receipt. If it's missing, we can nudge the seller.
steps: Ask for the order number.
Confirm the goods receipt was generated.
If yes, send an invoice reminder to the seller.
Explain that payment can't start until the invoice is uploaded.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Payments & Invoices → Invoice missing for order
branches.description: Sellers upload the invoice after your goods receipt. If it's missing, we can nudge the seller.

branches.agent_script: Card payments are declined by the issuing bank, not by us. Let's check the usual causes before trying again.
steps: Ask for the decline message shown at checkout.
Check whether the order total exceeds the card's per-transaction limit.
Ask the caller to confirm the card is enabled for online purchases.
Offer invoice-based payment if the organisation has it enabled.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Payments & Invoices → Corporate card declined at checkout
branches.description: Card payments are declined by the issuing bank, not by us. Let's check the usual causes before trying again.

branches.branch_name: Raise a dispute against a seller
branches.agent_script: You can raise a dispute from the order page; the seller gets seven days to respond.
steps: Ask for the order number and the nature of the issue.
Guide the caller to Order > Raise dispute.
Have them attach evidence such as photos or reports.
Explain the seven-day seller response window.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Disputes & Feedback → Raise a dispute against a seller
branches.description: You can raise a dispute from the order page; the seller gets seven days to respond.

branches.agent_script: Seller ratings help other buyers. You can rate after the goods receipt.
steps: Ask the caller to open the completed order.
Guide them to 'Rate seller' and score delivery, quality and communication.
Explain that ratings can be edited within 30 days.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Disputes & Feedback → Rate a seller after delivery
branches.description: Seller ratings help other buyers. You can rate after the goods receipt.

branches.agent_script: If your complaint hasn't been resolved in time, I can escalate it to the dispute cell.
steps: Ask for the dispute ID.
Check how long the dispute has been open.
If past the response window, escalate to the dispute cell.
Share the escalation reference with the caller.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Disputes & Feedback → Escalate an unresolved complaint
branches.description: If your complaint hasn't been resolved in time, I can escalate it to the dispute cell.

branches.agent_script: Accounts can be closed once there are no open orders, bids or payments.
steps: Check for open orders, active bids and pending payments.
Ask the organisation admin to submit a closure request with a letter.
Explain that records are retained for audit after closure.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Account Closure → Close a buyer account
branches.description: Accounts can be closed once there are no open orders, bids or payments.

branches.agent_script: Before closing, open orders must be completed or moved to another active buyer.
steps: List the open orders with the caller.
Guide the admin to reassign each order to an active buyer.
Confirm no orders remain before submitting closure.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Account Closure → Transfer pending orders before closure
branches.description: Before closing, open orders must be completed or moved to another active buyer.

branches.agent_script: Closed accounts can be reactivated within 90 days with a request from the organisation.
steps: Check when the account was closed.
If within 90 days, collect a reactivation letter from the organisation.
If older than 90 days, explain that a fresh registration is required.
branches.tagging: Buyer → Account Closure → Reactivate a closed account
branches.description: Closed accounts can be reactivated within 90 days with a request from the organisation.
